'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] announce that [[Al-Qassam Brigades]] commander Muhammad Bassam Mushtaha, who was accused of taking [[List of Gaza war hostages|hostages]] during and after the [[Hamas]]–led attacks against [[Israel]] on [[October 7 attacks|October 7]], was killed in a recent airstrike last month in northern [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. *[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***Heavy fighting erupts in [[El Obeid]], [[North Kordofan]], [[Sudan]], between the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] and [[Rapid Support Forces]] (RSF). Clashes also break out in Umm Arda. [https://sudantribune.com/article/317390 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
***Around 14 people are reported to be killed following an attack by RSF militants on the North Kordofan town of Umm Arda. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2654719/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')] [https://english.news.cn/africa/20260815/34cada1407eb4ebeb3feb02918b35e0c/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**A [[National Army of Colombia|Colombian soldier]] is killed and four more wounded following a [[drone strike]] in the rural area of [[El Carmen, Norte de Santander]]. [https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/ataque-drones-explosivos-militar-muerto-cuatro-heridos-norte-de-santander-GG39959924#google_vignette (''El Colombiano'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**A constable [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police|policeman]] is killed and another is injured after a group of suspected insurgents attacked a police post in [[Bajaur district]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/2022779/cop-martyred-another-injured-in-terrorist-attack-on-police-post-in-bajaur (''Dawn'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
** Three gunmen are killed and a child is wounded in an attempted ambush on a highway in [[La Piedad]], [[Michoacán]], [[Mexico]]. Authorities seize four long guns, magazines, ammunition, and improvised explosives. [https://heraldodemexico.com.mx/nacional/2026/8/14/hombres-armados-disparan-contra-soldados-en-la-piedad-hay-tres-muertos-un-adolescente-lesionado-869374.html (''El Heraldo de México'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]
*[[War in the Sahel]]
**American missionary Kevin Rideout is released from captivity after being kidnapped by an unidentified organisation front in [[Niger]] nine months prior. [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/14/world/africa/american-missionary-niger-rideout-released.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Croatia wildfires]]
**One person dies and at least 40 others are injured after a severe wildfire breaks out on [[Croatia]]'s coastline. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9342wn2x27o (BBC News)]
*[[2026 Flores earthquake]]
**At least 47 people are killed and several more are injured when a {{M|w|7.7}} earthquake strikes the coast of the island of [[Flores]] in [[East Nusa Tenggara]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-earthquake-magnitude-77-c31ad3cf07fa83d2d443e8d85e5c9d84 (AP)]
*A {{M|w|4.8}} earthquake strikes the [[province of Granada]] in [[Spain]], with damage reported in [[Granada]] and the surrounding area, and being felt in [[Madrid]]. [https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/1412340-spain-rocked-by-48-magnitude-earthquake-with-epicentre-near-granada (''The News International'')]
*Sixteen people are killed and 40 others injured on the [[Yaounde]]-[[Bafoussam]] highway after a passenger bus crashed into a parked truck carrying planks in [[Mbam-et-Inoubou]], [[Cameroon]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260814/a2db5088bb1844e391b54cc3f48a8e9e/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Thailand|Thai]] rescuers find a French [[Tourism in Thailand|tourist]] and his two sons alive after they spend more than 16 hours at [[Gulf of Thailand|sea]] when their rented jet ski capsizes off [[Ko Samui]]. The family receives medical checks and is discharged. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/thailand-jet-ski-family-rescue/ (CBS News)]
*Heavy rainfall persists in [[Eastern China]] due to the remnants of [[Typhoon Dolphin]], resulting in flooding in [[Zhejiang]] province, [[China]], killing atleast one. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/mudslide-eastern-china-kills-one-more-heavy-rain-expected-2026-08-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Internet censorship in France]]
**The [[Constitutional Council (France)|Constitutional Council]] of [[France]] blocks a bill proposing a ban on [[social media]] access for minors under the age of 15. [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] orders [[Prime Minister of France|prime minister]] [[Sebastien Lecornu]] to re-work the draft legislation and resubmit it to the Council. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20260814-top-french-court-scraps-social-media-ban-for-children-under-15 (RFI)] [https://www.businessoffashion.com/news/media/frances-top-court-blocks-social-media-ban-for-under-15s/ (''Business of Fashion'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 political prisoner release in Venezuela]]
**[[Venezuela]] releases 131 detainees under alternative custody measures as part of a national reconciliation program following former [[President of Venezuela|president]] [[Nicolás Maduro]]'s [[2026 United States intervention in Venezuela|removal]]. [[Human rights in Venezuela|Human rights]] group [[Foro Penal]] confirms that at least 45 of those freed are [[Political prisoners in Venezuela|political prisoners]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260814-venezuela-frees-more-political-prisoners-amid-post-maduro-talks (AFP via RFI)]
